findings.highlight: When I wake up
findings.evidenceJa: 白い陽射しに目を覚ました時
findings.governingReading: when he wakes in white sunlight
findings.explanation: The opening’s pale morning light disappears.

findings.highlight: Sakura will finish it herself
findings.evidenceJa: 桜一人に任せっきりになってしまう
findings.governingReading: the breakfast preparation will be left entirely to Sakura alone
findings.explanation: Concern about unfairly leaving all work to Sakura becomes concern that she will complete it before Shirou arrives.

findings.highlight: I don’t have the guts to look inside her room
findings.evidenceJa: 襖を開けるほどの勇気はない
findings.governingReading: he lacks the courage to open the fusuma
findings.explanation: A concrete sliding partition and the act of opening it become a generic look into Saber’s room.

findings.highlight: It’ll be troublesome if I see Saber sleeping.
findings.evidenceJa: 朝から色々タイヘンなのだ
findings.governingReading: seeing Saber asleep would make all sorts of things difficult first thing in the morning
findings.explanation: The early-morning timing and deliberately euphemistic breadth of Shirou’s embarrassment disappear.

findings.highlight: don’t you think you should settle down?
findings.evidenceJa: 少しは落ち着こうと思わんのかドラ娘
findings.governingReading: can’t you try to settle down a little, you troublesome or wayward daughter?
findings.explanation: The elder’s pointed comic form of address disappears.

findings.highlight: Fuji-nee didn’t come over last night because her grandfather collapsed.
findings.evidenceJa: 藤ねえのお父さんが倒れてしまった
findings.governingReading: Fuji-nee’s father collapsed, according to this narration
findings.explanation: mirror moon silently changes the source’s father reference to grandfather, erasing a live kinship discrepancy that must remain visible for later reconciliation.

findings.highlight: Fuji-nee complains
findings.evidenceJa: ぷんすか、と不平不満をこぼしつつ
findings.governingReading: Fuji-nee grumbles and complains with a comic punsuka huff
findings.explanation: Taiga’s cartoonishly indignant delivery is flattened.

findings.highlight: A wandering cloud is an idler!
findings.evidenceJa: はぐれ雲は遊び人っ
findings.governingReading: a wandering cloud means an idle pleasure-seeker or playboy
findings.explanation: The social type’s pursuit of amusement is reduced to inactivity.

findings.highlight: a person who does nothing but go around town to mock people
findings.evidenceJa: 町の人たちをひやかして面白おかしく暮らす人
findings.governingReading: someone who spends all day teasing townspeople and living an amusing, carefree life
findings.explanation: Playful teasing and enjoyable living become the harsher and narrower act of mocking people.

findings.highlight: Is your father sick?
findings.evidenceJa: お父さんの体、芳しくないんですか
findings.governingReading: is your father’s condition not favorable?
findings.explanation: Sakura’s cautious question about his condition becomes a direct illness diagnosis.

findings.highlight: sumo wrestled with one of the younger guys
findings.evidenceJa: 若い子と相撲して
findings.governingReading: wrestled in sumo with a younger person
findings.explanation: An ungendered singular partner becomes one member of an asserted group of young men.

findings.highlight: your weak point is covered
findings.evidenceJa: 急所は隠してる
findings.governingReading: the vital or private parts are covered
findings.explanation: A bodily euphemism is transferred literally into unnatural singular “weak point.”

findings.highlight: her miso soup
findings.evidenceJa: あさりのみそ汁
findings.governingReading: clam miso soup
findings.explanation: The specific soup punctuating Taiga’s outrageous claim is generalized.

findings.highlight: You have a loincloth too!
findings.evidenceJa: まわし持ってるくせに
findings.governingReading: you own a mawashi
findings.explanation: The sport-specific garment is collapsed into the generic fundoshi/loincloth category immediately after the scene distinguishes them.

findings.highlight: told you to do a different sport because you wouldn’t give up until you won, so he made you start archery
findings.evidenceJa: 違う競技にしなさいって言って、勝つまでやめたがらない士郎に弓持たせた
findings.governingReading: told Shirou to choose a different competition and put a bow in the hands of the child who refused to stop until he won
findings.explanation: The vivid bow handoff and causal sequence of redirecting Shirou’s competitiveness are reduced to starting a sport.

findings.highlight: she’s louder than usual
findings.evidenceJa: いつもより二割増で騒がしい
findings.governingReading: she is twenty percent noisier than usual
findings.explanation: The mock-quantified degree of Taiga’s heightened energy disappears.

findings.highlight: Morning club activities are cancelled starting today.
findings.evidenceJa: 昨日から朝の部活は禁止された
findings.governingReading: morning club activities have been prohibited since yesterday
findings.explanation: The policy’s start moves forward by a day and “prohibited” is weakened to cancelled.

findings.highlight: some people in the track team got injured during practice
findings.evidenceJa: 陸上部の子なんだけど、部活中にケガしちゃって
findings.governingReading: a track-club student was injured during practice
findings.explanation: The initially singular report is prematurely pluralized, spoiling the later reveal that the real count exceeds ten.

findings.highlight: I guess it’s because of lack of sleep
findings.evidenceJa: 保健の笠間先生に言わせれば寝不足だとかで
findings.governingReading: according to school nurse Kasama, it was due to sleep deprivation
findings.explanation: A named professional attribution becomes Taiga’s unsupported guess.

findings.highlight: It’s their own fault
findings.evidenceJa: 自己管理能力の不足
findings.governingReading: a deficiency in the person’s self-management
findings.explanation: Shirou’s specific, interrupted explanation is moralized into generic blame.

findings.highlight: between ten and twenty students
findings.evidenceJa: 十人以上二十人未満
findings.governingReading: at least ten but fewer than twenty people
findings.explanation: Precise inclusive and exclusive bounds become an ambiguous range that may include twenty.

findings.highlight: Fuji-nee pretends to cry.
findings.evidenceJa: よよよ、と泣き崩れる
findings.governingReading: Taiga collapses into theatrical “yoyoyo” weeping
findings.explanation: The exaggerated physical and vocal performance becomes generic pretend crying.

findings.highlight: two and a half bowls of rice isn’t her normal serving
findings.evidenceJa: 二杯半程度では全力ではない
findings.governingReading: two and a half bowls are not enough for the resident tiger to reach full power
findings.explanation: The fighting-strength metaphor is rewritten as a statistical claim about Taiga’s normal portion.

findings.highlight: your second full bowl
findings.evidenceJa: ごはん、大盛りで二杯目
findings.governingReading: her second heaping bowl of rice
findings.explanation: A large heaped serving becomes merely a filled bowl.

findings.highlight: I have to push myself and eat extra
findings.evidenceJa: 多少無理でも食べておかないと
findings.governingReading: she must make herself eat even if it is somewhat difficult
findings.explanation: Physical effort or discomfort is reframed as choosing additional quantity.

findings.highlight: all the gluttons around her
findings.evidenceJa: 身近に大食漢がいると
findings.governingReading: having a big eater close by
findings.explanation: One salient nearby big eater becomes multiple gluttons and adds a more contemptuous label.

findings.highlight: does not have sufficient strength as an archer
findings.evidenceJa: 弓使いとしては腕力が足りません
findings.governingReading: lacks arm strength as an archer
findings.explanation: The specific physical deficit Saber identifies is generalized.

findings.highlight: take in extra energy
findings.evidenceJa: 栄養を摂る
findings.governingReading: take in nutrition
findings.explanation: Nutrition is replaced by an unsupported “extra” energy quantity.

findings.highlight: is she missing the original topic?
findings.evidenceJa: 噛み合っているようで微妙にズレている
findings.governingReading: the conversation seems to fit together while remaining subtly misaligned
findings.explanation: A delicate comic near-fit among everyone’s explanations becomes Saber simply losing track of the topic.
